Subject: TalonTech demo — can we get a VP/CTO in the room?

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the run-through earlier this month — TalonTech's platform team is excited to see an end-to-end demo focused on latency and cost controls for our mixed workload. Our CIO, Samir, is scheduling a 45-minute session for next week and has asked whether a VP-level or CTO representative from Redwood can join for the first 15–20 minutes to speak to reliability guarantees and canary/fallback behavior.

We are proposing: Monday 24 May or Tuesday 25 May, windows between 09:00–12:00 PT. If an exec can't make it, Samir asked for a short (10–15 min) pre-brief or an executive one-pager so he knows what to expect.

Can you confirm who can join? We need a firm answer by EOD Monday so we can lock the calendar on our side.

Thanks,
Jane

Short answer: we can commit executive coverage, but need to confirm exact availability. Marcus (cc) is our Head of Solutions and usually covers the exec portion; when Marcus' calendar is tight we have Tessa (VP CS) step in as the sponsor — both are briefed on reliability and SLO fallbacks.

Proposed plan:
- If Marcus can make 15–20 mins at the top of the call, he’ll handle the executive framing and critical SLAs.
- If Marcus is unavailable, Tessa will join and we’ll send a 1-page exec summary to Samir before the call.

Please tentatively hold Monday 24 May, 09:30–10:15 PT (we'll confirm by EOD). If that works for you we will follow up with a final calendar invite and an agenda (30-min product demo + 15-min exec Q&A).

I’ve attached an exec one-pager and a short agenda draft.
